candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from order-service calls to payment timing out: traces show POST payment ReadTimeout (~2s) and POST order ReadTimeout, while inventory/redis calls succeed in ~2ms. Gateway returns 502 after ~2s, matching the payment timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-service-side telemetry; whether payment is slow or unreachable is not directly observed. Order service also shows ReadTimeout, so the exact slow hop is inferred.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment authorization ReadTimeout (~2s) propagating to order and checkout 502s, with inventory/redis healthy. Gateway logs confirm transport errors to order at ~2s. Bounded to downstream latency on the payment path; payment-side evidence is missing.
